description: Core 11.04 BEFORE MOVING: charge targets are enemy units "within 12\" of your unit and within the maximum distance of your unit"; AFTER MOVING: "Your unit must be engaged with all of the charge targets". 19.01: "An attached unit is a single unit for all rules purposes", so the leader's models count. Review fix for the 11e within-the-roll change: the selectable list measured from the whole Attached unit, but the post-roll success check (_is_charge_roll_sufficient / _per_target_charge_requirements) and the pre-roll 12" checks (RulesEngine.charge_targets_within_12 -> the UNITS THAT CAN CHARGE filter and ELIGIBLE TARGETS rows, ChargePhase._is_target_within_charge_range -> DECLARE_CHARGE) measured only the bodyguard. Real clicks on the charge panel. (A) Blade Champion 10.0" from the Boyz, his Custodian Guard 12.5"+ away: the Attached unit is listed, its target row reads 10.0", and the dashed 12" envelope contains the Boyz. (B) Blade Champion 6.5" away, Custodian Guard 9.4"+ away: the player selects the target and declares BEFORE the roll (the only way the UI declares), the hint asks for 6.5" and 'Min roll' is 7; the UI roll is pinned to 7 — before the fix the charge FAILED here with a false 'terrain' explanation; now it continues, Snap to Contact puts the leader in contact, and Confirm completes an engaged charge.

steps.comment: 19.01 linkage in both directions, as formations write it (CharacterAttachmentManager); the stock fixture carries only the bodyguard's forward list, which leaves the leader listed as a separate charger

Layout A (40px = 1"; 40mm radius 31.496px, 32mm radius 25.197px): the Blade Champion 10.0" south of the Boyz model at (600, 592); his Custodian Guard behind him, 12.5"-13.4" away (beyond 12"). 19.01: the Attached unit is one unit, so it is within 12" of the Boyz through its leader.

steps.script:
var m = tree.root.get_node("Main")
var focus := Vector2(600.0, 860.0)
var z := 1.2
var vp: Vector2 = m.get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
m.camera.position = focus
m.camera.zoom = Vector2(z, z)
m.view_zoom = z
m.view_offset = focus - vp / (2.0 * z)
m.update_view_transform()
return true
steps.comment: frame the leader, his bodyguard and the Boyz
UNITS THAT CAN CHARGE lists the Attached unit (RulesEngine.charge_targets_within_12 now measures from the leader too; before the fix it was filtered out)
the row's distance is measured from the leader
the dashed 12" charge envelope is drawn around the leader too, so it contains the Boyz
Layout B: the Blade Champion 6.5" from the Boyz; the Custodian Guard 9.4"-10.3" away — beyond even roll + 2" ER on a 7, so only the leader can end the charge engaged.
pre-roll hint: the roll needed is the leader's 6.5" (11.04: within the roll)
trajectory 'Min roll' also measures from the leader
the UI declares the target BEFORE the roll — the path whose post-roll check used to ignore the leader
the next unseeded 2D6 (the UI charge roll) is 7
keep the 7 if a re-roll prompt is offered
11.04 / 19.01: the leader can end engaged, so the 7 does NOT fail (before the fix: FAILED with a false terrain message)
the game log records the roll as a SUCCESS against the leader's 6.5"
Snap to Contact puts the leader (6.5" away) into contact
11.04 AFTER MOVING: the Attached unit is engaged with its charge target through its leader
